jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Revenue Operations Specialist/Manager to run and own the business layer of RevOps alongside Sales, CS, and Marketing. As a partner to the GTM leaders and teams, you'll own their operating rhythm day to day and translate their requirements into precise, build-ready requests.




ABOUT DATASNIPPER 🚀

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Define and run the operating rhythm

 - Run point in pipeline reviews, weekly syncs, and QBR prep across Sales, CS, and Marketing.

 - Own the full QBR end to end - narrative, data pull, slides, pre-read, agenda, and follow-up actions.

 - Pull and interpret the numbers before every pipeline review or weekly sync - not just the data, but the story behind it.

Translate field needs into build-ready briefs

 - Convert business and system needs from any of the three functions into precise, build-ready briefs that GTM Engineering can execute against immediately, helping achieve your goals alongside the GTM leaders.

Own process and drive improvement

 - Own the operating model for the functions you support - how deals move through stages, handoff criteria, what "at-risk" means, what a qualified opportunity looks like.

 - Spot what's breaking - a misfiring routing rule, a renewal that fell through a process gap - and drive the fix, whether that's a system request, a process change, or a direct conversation.

Shape planning and quota-setting

 - Bring Sales, CS, and Marketing context into annual planning and quota-setting, stress-testing whether targets are realistic against what you see on the ground.



WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2-3+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Marketing Operations, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment, with a hunger to innovate, learn, and self-start in a fast-paced environment.

 - Technical comfort. You're comfortable working in HubSpot or an equivalent CRM day to day, and understand the basics of Customer Revenue Systems.

 - Sharp communication. You can translate ambiguous asks into precise, actionable briefs in a room full of stakeholders.

 - An ownership habit. Detail-oriented and organised, you own a QBR end to end rather than handing off pieces of it.

 - Cross-functional range. You're comfortable supporting Sales, CS, and Marketing at once, switching between their different rhythms and priorities day to day, and are eager to bridge context between these teams.

 - AI-forward. You use AI tools to speed up data pulls, QBR prep, and briefs, and you're always looking for the next manual step to automate.

What you'll work with:

 - CRM and prospecting: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dealhub

 - Contracts and commissions: Juro, DocuSign, Qobra

 - Data and AI: Snowflake, Claude

Haven't used all of these? That's fine. Strong CRM basics matter most, and we'll help you learn the rest.

Nice to have:
A HubSpot certification (or similar), or experience building AI assisted RevOps workflows.



WHAT WE OFFER

 - Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

 - Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

 - Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

 - 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

 - Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

 - Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

 - NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

 - A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

 - Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

 - Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

 - Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

 - Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 


RECRUITMENT PROCESS

 1. Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

 2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

 3. Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)

 4. Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

 

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:

Senior Customer Success Manager

As a Senior Customer Success Manager at DataSnipper, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers achieve their goals using our innovative, AI-powered solutions. You will own the customer journey, from onboarding to driving long-term value and retention, fostering strong relationships built on trust and collaboration. You’ll help customers unlock their potential value while contributing to the growth and success of our business.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with professionals who are the backbone of global capital markets, deliver exceptional service, and build a thriving community for our customers. If you’re passionate about customer success and ready to own the moment, we’d love to hear from you!

 


ABOUT DATASNIPPER 

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Act as a Trusted Advisor: Serve as a strategic partner to key stakeholders including Audit Partners and Managers, Controllers, Finance Directors, and IT decision-makers, guiding them through business transformation enabled by DataSnipper. 

 - Drive Business Transformation: Help customers reimagine their workflows and processes, demonstrating how DataSnipper’s AI-powered capabilities can deliver measurable efficiency gains, cost savings, and quality improvements across audit and finance functions.

 - Deliver Strategic Consultative Solutions: Provide expert guidance tailored to each customer’s unique business challenges, helping them optimise audit and finance workflows and achieve their strategic objectives using DataSnipper.

 - Business Transformation Focus: Proven ability to help customers reimagine processes and workflows, demonstrating how technology can drive measurable business outcomes.

 - Accountability and Ownership: Strong sense of ownership and the drive to master your craft, take initiative, and ensure no detail is overlooked.

 - Collaborative Spirit: Thrives in cross-functional teamwork and builds meaningful partnerships with customers and internal stakeholders.

 - Adaptability and Growth Mindset: Learns quickly and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where customer needs and priorities evolve.

 - Excellence in Communication: Professional fluency in English and Dutch or French (written and spoken), with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels - from audit associates to C-suite.

 - Audit Background: Hands-on experience in external or internal audit, or assurance is nice to have

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Former Auditor
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Former Auditor - Customer Success Manager

As a Customer Success Manager (+Audit Background) at DataSnipper, you own the success of a portfolio of accounts - and you bring something additional to the role: direct experience in audit. You understand how audit teams work, what drives their priorities, and how to connect DataSnipper to the workflows that matter most inside a firm.

You are a reliable, independent operator who applies established CS frameworks and uses your audit knowledge to accelerate adoption, build credibility with audit stakeholders, and design enablement that non-audit CSMs cannot replicate. You manage onboarding, QBRs, health monitoring, and renewals with predictability and follow-through and you do it in a language audit professionals trust.

You may still be developing the full breadth of CS scope, but your audit domain credibility opens doors and unlocks conversations that are otherwise harder to access at this level.




ABOUT DATASNIPPER 

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Act as a Credible Audit Advisor: Serve as a trusted partner to Audit Managers, Senior Auditors, and engagement team leads. You are someone who understands customer workflows, their quality standards, and their firm's operating model. Translate DataSnipper's capabilities into language and use cases that resonate with audit professionals directly.

 - Drive Adoption Aligned to Audit Workflows: Run onboarding and training sessions that are grounded in how audit teams actually work - mapping DataSnipper features to real engagement tasks, sample testing approaches, and evidence management requirements.

 - Manage Account Health with Audit Context: Use product data, stakeholder signals, and your understanding of audit operating rhythms to monitor portfolio health. Recognize when signals carry firm-wide implications such as low adoption and respond or escalate with the right context.

 - Build Audit-Grounded Success Plans: Create success plans that connect DataSnipper capabilities to audit-specific outcomes: engagement efficiency, sample coverage, review cycle speed, and quality compliance. Align milestones to audit calendar realities and firm methodology, not just generic product adoption targets.

 - Communicate ROI in Audit Terms: Articulate the business impact DataSnipper delivers using metrics and framing that carry weight with audit professionals - time saved per engagement, risk reduction, quality improvement. Run QBRs and stakeholder conversations with the credibility of someone who has worked in the field.

 - Support Expansion Using Domain Knowledge: Identify expansion signals within your portfolio and use your understanding of firm structure such as service lines, team hierarchies, engagement types to surface credible growth opportunities. Support Sales in building ROI cases that resonate with audit leadership.

 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally with Audit Insight: Share audit workflow intelligence with Product, Sales, and Solutions Engineering. Surface patterns that require audit expertise to interpret - methodology gaps, adoption friction specific to audit processes, feedback that non-audit CSMs are less positioned to identify.

 - Contribute Audit Knowledge to the Team: Help peers understand audit customer context. Act as an accessible internal resource for audit-specific questions to help raise the team's collective ability to serve audit accounts.

 - Maintain Systems and Portfolio Data: Keep customer data, health signals, and portfolio records accurate and up to date in internal systems. Use this data to make better decisions and support reliable reporting.
   
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Audit Domain Credibility: You have worked in or directly alongside audit teams. You understand engagement lifecycles, sample testing, evidence management, team hierarchies, and the quality standards that govern audit work. This is not background knowledge - it is something you apply directly in customer conversations and account planning.

 - Experience: Ideally you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role in B2B SaaS, combined with direct experience in audit - whether as an auditor, audit technology specialist, or in a client-facing role embedded in audit workflows. You understand how audit engagements are structured, what drives adoption in audit teams, and how to speak credibly to audit professionals.

 - Audit-Specific Enablement Design: You can design and execute onboarding and training programs that map to real audit workflows - including audit cycle timing, firm methodology, and engagement team structure. This requires audit fluency that cannot be substituted with general CS experience.

 - Reliable Execution: You follow through. You manage a portfolio independently, hit your commitments, and deliver consistent outcomes without needing close supervision.

 - Data-Driven Approach: You use product data and health signals to stay ahead of risks and make decisions. You are comfortable in CS tools and CRM platforms.

 - Clear Communication across Contexts: You communicate clearly in both audit professional language and CS/GTM contexts. You can navigate stakeholder conversations with audit managers and firm leadership, and translate those conversations back into internal action.

 - Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your accounts and your own development. You ask for feedback, apply it, and look for ways to improve.

 - Collaborative Spirit: You contribute to the team including by sharing audit knowledge that makes peers more effective on audit accounts.

 - Adaptability: You handle change well. You adjust when priorities shift and keep a constructive attitude in a fast-moving environment.
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Excellent salary + stock participation plan

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Comprehensive medical and dental coverage

 - 401K match

 - Paid parental leave

 - Company-sponsored lunch

 - Hybrid mode of work (at least 3 days onsite in our New York City office)

 - Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

 - Make an impact by disrupting the finance industry with us

 - A flexible and growing organization with lots of opportunities to learn and develop

 - International working environment, with a team of friendly and driven colleagues

 - Access to OpenUp and Talkspace, the mental health and wellness platform

 - Multiple social activities for team building 🤩

jobs.title: Director of Customer Success - Americas
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Customer Success - Americas at DataSnipper, you lead the regional Customer Success organization responsible for adoption, retention, customer value, and team performance across the Americas. You are accountable for turning DataSnipper into measurable business impact across Mid-Market, Enterprise, audit, and non-audit customer segments, while building the leadership system that allows managers and CSMs to execute consistently at scale.

You operate as a second-line leader: managing Customer Success Managers, raising the bar for Senior ICs, and translating company strategy into a practical regional operating rhythm. Over the next 6–12 months, this role will be central to helping the Americas CS organization scale adoption of DataSnipper’s agentic platform, connect implementation to durable customer value, and align the business to the rapid evolution of AI adoption among frontier accounting firms in the US.

You also represent the Americas voice in CS and Company leadership. You bring insight from customers, managers, portfolio data, implementation learnings, and market signals into company-level conversations. You act as a pulse on where the market is moving and what customers are asking for next, partnering closely with Sales, Product, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, Enablement, and GTM leadership to improve how DataSnipper serves customers across the region.




ABOUT DATASNIPPER 

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Lead the Americas CS Business: Own regional CS performance across adoption, retention, customer health, value realization, manager effectiveness, and team execution. Translate global CS priorities, including the agentic platform transition, into a clear operating rhythm for the region.

 - Manage and Develop Managers: Lead Customer Success Managers with clarity, accountability, and coaching. Help them inspect portfolio health, raise team standards, develop CSMs, and make strong calls on risk, prioritization, escalation, and change management.

 - Drive Customer Outcomes at Scale: Ensure CSMs deliver trusted advisory, product adoption, value discovery, Strategic Business Reviews, account health management, ROI communication, and strong portfolio hygiene across segments. Make sure implementation and first-90-day adoption motions create durable value and clean handoffs into long-term Customer Success.

 - Lead Renewal Risk and Executive Engagement: Partner with Sales, Account Management, RevOps, and CS leadership to maintain forecast discipline, surface material risks early, and engage senior customer stakeholders when regional importance, risk, or opportunity requires it.

 - Operationalize CS Strategy and Culture: Turn global CS initiatives into repeatable regional practices around account planning, customer health, manager coaching, escalation management, adoption measurement, and performance tracking while reinforcing a high-accountability, customer-first culture.

 - Represent the Americas Market Voice: Bring clear regional insight to CS and Company leadership, including how frontier accounting firms in the US are evolving their expectations around AI and agentic workflows. Use data, customer examples, manager feedback, implementation learnings, and market signals to influence product, GTM, resourcing, process, and prioritization.

 - Partner Cross-Functionally with Impact: Work with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Marketing, and Enablement to remove blockers, share customer intelligence, improve adoption and implementation motions, and ensure the Americas voice of customer is visible in company-level decisions.
   
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Required experience: 8+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Implementation, or a related customer-facing function in B2B SaaS, with 4+ years in CS leadership and meaningful experience managing managers.

 - Second-Line Leadership: You have led managers before, or operated at a level where you coached leaders, inspected team performance through others, and influenced outcomes across multiple teams or segments.

 - Customer Success Operating Depth: You understand the full CS motion: onboarding, implementation, adoption, health management, risk mitigation, Strategic Business Reviews, renewals, expansion support, executive engagement, and voice of customer.

 - Regional and Commercial Ownership: You know how to run a regional business within a global CS organization. You understand how CS contributes to retention, expansion, and long-term customer value, and you partner effectively with Sales and Account Management without blurring ownership.

 - AI and Agentic Platform Adoption Leadership: You understand how AI-enabled workflows change customer expectations, adoption patterns, and value realization. You can help teams connect agentic platform capabilities to customer outcomes, coach through adoption friction, and translate market movement into internal action.

 - Data-Driven Executive Judgment: You use product data, health signals, forecast movement, customer sentiment, portfolio trends, implementation milestones, manager insight, and market signals to make decisions and influence company-level priorities.

 - Manager Coaching and Talent Development: You help managers improve their teams through clear expectations, inspection rhythms, feedback, prioritization, and accountability. You can hire, onboard, coach, and retain strong CS talent while identifying future leaders.

 - Cross-Functional Influence and Communication: You build strong partnerships with Sales, Product, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, Enablement, and GTM leaders. You communicate clearly, make tradeoffs visible, summarize risk without drama, and turn customer patterns into actionable internal insight.

 - Process, Scale, and Adaptability: You build repeatable systems without overcomplicating the work. You know when to standardize, when to adapt, and when to simplify, and you help teams stay focused through change.

 - Audit, Finance, or Data Automation Exposure: Experience with audit, accounting, finance, AI adoption, or workflow automation customers is a strong plus, especially where you have supported enterprise adoption, change management, or AI-enabled transformation.
   
   This role is your opportunity to live out DataSnipper’s EMPWR values, owning the moment to build a high-performing Americas CS organization, move customers into DataSnipper’s agentic future, and raise the standard for how we deliver measurable customer outcomes at scale. If this sounds appealing to you, please apply! We'd love to speak with you!

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - DACH - Audit background
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE 

As a Customer Success Manager - DACH at DataSnipper, you’ll bring something most CSMs simply don’t have - a deep understanding of the audit world. Your background in audit or accounting isn’t just relevant here; it’s the foundation of everything you’ll do. You’ll speak your customers’ language, understand their pressures, and know firsthand what it means to navigate complex financial workflows and tight deadlines.

In this role, you’ll move from doing the audit work to transforming how it’s done - partnering with audit and finance teams across the DACH region to help them unlock the full power of AI-driven automation.
